title: CDS Full Length Mock Test 05 (Hard Level)
description: Combined Defence Services Examination style full-length mock covering English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge. Hard level, 100 questions.
instructions: There is a penalty of 0.83 marks for every wrong answer.
No marks will be deducted for unattempted questions.
Choose the most appropriate option among the four given choices.
The paper covers English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge as in CDS.
Use of calculator or electronic device is not permitted.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part that contains an error: The column of vehicles, along with the recce party, / were delayed / at the river crossing / due to flash floods.
options: The column of vehicles, along with the recce party
questions.explanation: The true subject is singular 'column'; use 'was delayed'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: No sooner the ceasefire came into force / than both sides / began pulling back / from the contact line.
options: No sooner the ceasefire came into force
questions.explanation: Correct inversion: 'No sooner did the ceasefire come into force' or 'No sooner had the ceasefire come into force'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: One of the officers who / has been shortlisted / for the staff college / is from the artillery.
questions.explanation: The relative clause modifies 'officers' (plural); use 'have been shortlisted'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: The number of sorties flown / this month / are higher / than last month's tally.
questions.explanation: 'The number of' takes a singular verb: 'is higher'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Improve the underlined part: The patrol was ordered to hold fire unless they are fired upon.
options: until they would be fired upon
unless they were being fire upon
questions.explanation: Collective sense of 'patrol' as a unit takes singular 'it is fired upon'; also sequence of tenses after 'was ordered'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Improve: He suggested me to apply for the SSC.
questions.explanation: 'Suggest' is not followed by object + to-infinitive; use 'suggested that I apply'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Improve: If I would have known the password, I would have decrypted the message.
questions.explanation: Third conditional: If + past perfect, would have + V3.

The ridgeline was captured by the battalion.

questions.question: He said, 'I shall hold the post till last light.' Convert to indirect.
options: He said that he should hold the post till last light.
He said that he would hold the post till last light.
He said that I shall hold the post till last light.
He said that he will hold the post till last light.
questions.explanation: 'Shall' of first person becomes 'would' in reported speech.
